<p align="center"><strong>Ending 03 of 06 - The Familiar</strong></p>


<p align="center">Without the brass key to protect you, you sit on the bottom step. The cat settles in your lap. Its purring matches the scratching beneath the floor.</p>

<p align="center">You dream of chasing a ribbon through the house. When you wake, the stairs tower above you. Two black cats stare from the hallway mirror. Neither reflection belongs to a person.</p>

<p align="center">THE FAMILIAR - Next Halloween, you will try to warn the next visitor. All they will hear is a hiss. Choose GET UP AND EXPLORE to return to the moment before you fell asleep.</p>
